fullPassage: If our bodies know best, why are they easily injured when we do something so seemingly natural as running? On the one hand, running seems very easy, but that is only because our bodies are so very good at it. The most powerful supercomputer on the planet cannot administer the enormous number of computations it takes to run, untethered, on two legs. Wherever our running intelligence is, running is not all conscious to us and is so complicated that only the T-1000 Terminators of our imagination are able to do it. Because our running knowledge is buried so deeply within muscle fibres, cells and our DNA, we have to accept that we cannot fully explain its complexities. That doesn’t mean our bodies don’t know how to do it. We may feel our way towards understanding the alchemy of running by learning how to use our senses, getting them firing, and seeing what they are capable of, and accepting that our bodies know more about running than we ever will.

det.korean: alchemy = 연금술, 신비로운 작용.
det.analysis: 본문 'feel our way towards understanding the alchemy of running'에서 직접 확인

questions.passage: If our bodies know best, why are they easily injured when we do something so seemingly natural as running? On the one hand, running seems very easy, but that is only because our bodies are so very good at it. The most powerful supercomputer on the planet cannot administer the enormous number of computations it takes to run, untethered, on two legs. Wherever our running intelligence is, running is not all conscious to us and is so complicated that only the T-1000 Terminators of our imagination are able to do it. Because our running knowledge is buried so deeply within muscle fibres, cells and our DNA, we have to accept that we cannot fully explain its complexities. That doesn’t mean our bodies don’t know how to do it. We may feel our way towards understanding the alchemy of running by learning how to use our senses, getting them firing, and seeing what they are capable of, and accepting that our bodies know more about running than we ever will.

det.korean: untethered = (매이지 않고) 자유로운.

det.korean: understand(이해하다, 동사) → understanding(이해, 동명사): 전치사 towards 뒤에는 (동)명사가 온다.
det.analysis: feel our way towards __________: 전치사 towards의 목적어 자리이므로 동사 understand를 동명사 understanding으로 변환

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 주제: 우리 몸은 의식적 이해를 넘어서 달리기를 알고 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 단순히 쉬운 활동: 몸이 능숙해 쉬워 보일 뿐
❌ ② 슈퍼컴퓨터가 대체: cannot administer(처리 못 함)
✅ ③ 의식적 이해를 넘어선 몸의 앎: 글 전체 핵심 ←정답
❌ ④ 부상 회피 위해 자주 멈춤: 언급 없음

ch: 달리기는 누구나 쉽게 배우는 단순한 활동이다.
슈퍼컴퓨터가 곧 인간의 달리기 능력을 대체할 것이다.
우리 몸은 의식적 이해를 넘어 달리기를 알고 있다.
부상을 피하려면 달리기를 자주 멈추어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 요지: 달리기 지식은 몸속 깊이 있어 완전히 설명할 수 없지만, 몸은 그 방법을 안다.
det.analysis:

❌ ② 의식적으로 통제해야 잘함: not all conscious
❌ ③ 상상 속 로봇만 달림: 비유일 뿐 요지 아님
✅ ④ 깊이 묻힌 지식 + 몸은 방법을 앎: 글 전체 결론 ←정답

ch: 달리기의 모든 원리는 현대 과학으로 완벽히 설명할 수 있다.
달리기는 철저히 의식적으로 통제해야만 잘할 수 있다.
